label: Huang and Peng primary: Krewski et al. 2009 ACS extended follow-up, all-cause mortality
notes: Faithful Huang-Peng specification: their Table 3 defines DeltaPM as the InMAP scenario concentration and does not subtract the ACS minimum. The statistical model is extrapolated below the ACS observed range when total PM2.5 is below 10.77.

label: Burnett et al. 2018 GEMM NCD+LRI with Chinese male cohort, age-specific
notes: Age-specific theta and standard errors are loaded from gemm_ncd_lri_parameters.csv. Endpoint requires age-specific baseline mortality for noncommunicable diseases plus lower respiratory infections; generic non-accidental or all-cause mortality is not silently substituted.

notes: Primary Korean sensitivity. The paper reports a near-linear exposure-response over the observed range but does not validate extrapolation to zero; counterfactual zero follows the unthresholded scenario-total convention and is flagged in outputs.

notes: The source cohort starts at age 18. With KOSIS five-year bands the pipeline conservatively begins at 20-24 rather than splitting 15-19. The reported association was clearer above about 18 ug/m3, but 18 is not encoded as a biological no-effect threshold.
